descriptor.checkpoint_text: Your friend can carry on from here.
descriptor.summary: A house with a workshop, a loft and a sunroom.
descriptor.title: A House for Two

open-the-house.hint_a: There's more than one way through the workshop.
open-the-house.hint_b: Go to the bell in the loft.
open-the-house.title: Open the House

the-room-below.hint_a: Look for a way down and retrieve the ball.
the-room-below.title: The Room Below

descriptor.checkpoint_text: Your friend can carry on from here.
descriptor.completion_text: Both lights are able to reach the garden.
descriptor.summary: Light the way through the conservatory and open a path back to the garden.
descriptor.title: Conservatory

a-light-above.hint_a: Point the light at the top steps.
a-light-above.title: A Light Above

the-way-light-returns.hint_a: Leave the lower crossing lit and wait in the garden.
the-way-light-returns.hint_b: Open the return shutter and bring both lights to the garden.
the-way-light-returns.title: The Way Light Returns

descriptor.checkpoint_text:
The lift has a memory of the way up. Your spirits remain in the same place.

Next: switch roles, drop the seed down, then open the garden.
descriptor.completion_text: The loft is open and the garden is growing. Your two saved stages can be played as a single memory.
descriptor.summary: Turn on the real lift, then share a seed and open the garden.
descriptor.title: First Steps

a-little-lift.hint_a: Stand on the power pad. Keep it glowing, then finish your recording.
a-little-lift.hint_b: Step onto the low lift. Ride up, walk to the bell and ring it.

a-place-to-grow.hint_a: Take the seed upstairs. Throw from the marked edge, then open the garden with the other pad.
a-place-to-grow.hint_b: Catch the seed at the lower ring. Bring it to the garden and plant when the leaves open.

descriptor.checkpoint_text: Your friend can carry on from here.
descriptor.summary: Explore the high paths and the islands below.
descriptor.title: High and Low

down-and-around.hint_a: Open a way through the lower islands.

upper-path.hint_a: Help your partner reach the loft.

descriptor.checkpoint_text: Your friend can carry on from here.
descriptor.summary: Leave a path for your partner and go back home together.
descriptor.title: Long Way Home

a-place-beside-you.hint_a: Pick a window to greet your partner when they come home.
a-place-beside-you.hint_b: Follow the open path and light the second window.
a-place-beside-you.title: A Place Beside You

the-path-you-leave.hint_a: Leave a trail for your partner and then go to the garden on your own.
the-path-you-leave.title: The Path You Leave

descriptor.checkpoint_text:
The relay will remember your seed and the first bridge will remain open. You may leave here and come back later.

Next: exchange spirits and bring the light to the far island.
descriptor.completion_text: Three islands are awake. You can now play your two saved stages together as one memory.
descriptor.summary: Two recorded handoffs between three islands.
descriptor.title: The Relay Isles

garden.hint_a: Take the seed from the relay. Hold the next plate and throw.
garden.hint_b: Follow both bridges, catch the seed and plant it.

relay.hint_a: Hold the west plate and throw to the middle island.
relay.hint_b: Catch the seed, then place it in the relay socket.

descriptor.checkpoint_text: Your friend can carry on from here.
descriptor.summary: Pass a ball around, open the crossings and navigate around the garden.
descriptor.title: Rolling Home

bring-it-home.hint_a: Bring the ball back for your partner.

weight-of-a-friend.hint_a: Help your partner cross with the ball's weight.
weight-of-a-friend.hint_b: Find what keeps both crossings open.

descriptor.checkpoint_text: Your friend can carry on from here.
descriptor.completion_text: You're both out of the well.
descriptor.summary: One of you is holding the rope at the bottom of the well, while the other climbs. Then they come back for you.
descriptor.title: The Wishing Well

back-for-you.hint_a: They're still holding on. Bring the ladder down.
back-for-you.hint_b: Get out of the well and sound the bell.
back-for-you.title: Back for You

go-on-ahead.hint_a: Hop down and hold the rope.
go-on-ahead.title: Go On Ahead
